text:
Amelia Park: hey team! first day at Redwood 🙌 remote from oakland. heads up: i'm bringing sourdough energy (and questions). any desk plant custodians i should know about? also debating mechanical keyboard vs laptop only — what do folks at HQ use?
Noor (People Ops): welcome Amelia!! :tada: glad to have you. badge pickup is at reception between 9-4 — bring an ID. for plants and office policies, drop by People Ops desk on your second day and we'll do a quick office tour.
Juno: welcome!! if you're into plants we have a small plant swap every month. i brought a spider plant last time. keyboard rec: lots of people use low-profile mechanicals (Keychron is popular) but some swear by the laptop + external numpad for ergonomics.
Amelia Park: nice! i bake every weekend so i can trade sourdough for a plant? :bread:
Ben (IT): hey Amelia, for keyboards we usually offer a small stipend after 30 days if you want to buy peripherals. ping me and i can reserve a loaner keyboard (MX Brown-ish) for you to try. also, if you need dual monitor setup, say the word.
Sophie: hi Amelia :wave: also FYI there's a neighborhood coffee cart on thursdays that does espresso and oat lattes. good for a break.
onboard-bot: Hello Amelia — welcome to Redwood Inference! Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/onboard/checklist. IT request form: https://intranet.redwood.com/it/requests. Badge hours: M-F 9–4.
Amelia Park: love the idea of a sourdough-for-plant exchange :grin: when's the next swap?
Noor (People Ops): we usually announce plant-swap dates in #random and on the All Hands calendar — next one is in two weeks. also we'll add you to the plant-swap thread.
Juno: vote: Bring sourdough to swap or bring a plant cutting? :raised_hands:
Amelia Park: both — i'll bring a small boule and a starter jar. deal?
Ben (IT): noted on the loaner keyboard. @Amelia Park if you want try-it-before-you-buy, stop by IT on the 3rd floor after lunch.
Sophie: sweet welcome sac for you: plant + bread + coffee run after orientation? :heart:
Amelia Park: sold. thanks everyone for the warm welcome — excited to meet IRL and maybe host a tiny sourdough demo :smile:
